candidates.name: DAS
candidates.evidence: Original cross-species supervised audio segmenter; fresh official repository now documents torch backend and final TensorFlow release 0.32.13. Closest established source-aligned specialist.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: TweetyNet
candidates.evidence: Spectrogram segmentation/labeling; must train/test by our bird split and merge labels consistently, not import bird-specific classification scores.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.evidence: Domain-adapted Whisper transformer includes Bengalese finch examples; checkpoint training overlap with held-out bird must be audited.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

candidates.name: AVN segmentation comparisons
candidates.evidence: Primary zebra finch study compares WhisperSeg/TweetyNet; relevant transfer evidence, different species and scoring.
candidates.role: contender; not evaluated on our frozen slice

current_best_claim_scope: Exact executed custom input/split/metric protocol, not best within our small inspected local set
current_reference: Training-only spectral boosting and event-postprocessing CV
current_reference_limitations: Current reference is conventional boosted spectral features, not DAS reproduction.
Boundary annotations are amplitude-segmented/human-labeled, not pristine/exhaustive vocalization truth.
Published frame/sample/label metrics do not match our event F1.
One held-out bird; A15 GPT-5.6 has a 268-line deviation.
recommended_next_comparator: Train DAS and TweetyNet using only our 60 training recordings with no bird IDs; score merged binary events on the exact 20 test recordings from bird or60yw70 and onset/offset tolerances. Add WhisperSeg as a separately labeled adapted-pretrained tier only after checking training overlap; retain all outputs/annotations.
switching_assessment: NO GENERAL REPLACEMENT RECOMMENDATION. Current evidence supports a bounded code-synthesis/pilot comparison to the named local reference. Establish prospective same-input/split/metric contender runs, biological/source replication, calibration and runtime/reliability before switching production tools.
limitations: Current reference is conventional boosted spectral features, not DAS reproduction.
Boundary annotations are amplitude-segmented/human-labeled, not pristine/exhaustive vocalization truth.
Published frame/sample/label metrics do not match our event F1.
One held-out bird; A15 GPT-5.6 has a 268-line deviation.
negative_findings: No matched 20-recording held-out bird event F1 leaderboard verified.
AVN zebra finch ranking does not establish Bengalese winner.
